correctness.rationale: In F_n(m), each triangle pair is a true-twin pair, so every forcing set contains at least one member. For m>=2, all leaves have the same sole neighbor, so all but at most one must initially be blue; equality gives size n+m-1 and exactly the claimed profiles, which force by leaf->center, triangle-pair forces, then center->last leaf. For m=1, size n stalls and every size n+1 forcing set is exhaustively one of three extra-vertex types. K3(1,1,1) has exactly the nine stated forcing pairs. Exhaustive packaged checks corroborate all small cases and the structural classification.

value.rationale: The result closes a natural invariant across an exact published finite-ring graph classification, including every minimum forcing set rather than only Z. The minimizer counts distinguish Yu–Wu families that share the same zero forcing number and expose the role of twin triangle pairs and pendant-leaf multiplicity. This is a complete structural classification on a motivated algebraic graph class.
